scope: One design-only acceptance review, using parent-supplied metadata

recommendations.title: Session bind ignores client account
recommendations.setup: Fixture: A and B server-bound mailboxes; fake Gmail fetch answers only for A. No live provider. Recommended: desktop client auths as A and posts B's id on real gateway HTTP; ManagedConnectors, Composio parser, ingestion, morning-task are real.
assertions: Bound mailbox is A's session only, never client id B.
Fake fetch runs only for A; B is never read.
Mail and morning task persist only on A; B is empty.
No client account override in response or rows.

recommendations.title: In-flight revoke keeps prior staff work
recommendations.setup: Fixture: prior staff mail and morning task ingested; second Gmail body blocked on fake fetch. Interleave: real sync, gateway revoke or cancel mid-read, then late success. Parser and store real. Not a live call.
assertions: Late success is not committed after revoke or cancel.
Prior staff mail and morning task stay unchanged.
No new mail or task row from the late payload.
Status stays revoked or cancelled; later sync does not replay.

recommendations.title: Canary key stays only at the gateway
recommendations.setup: Fixture canary only in gateway secret at fake fetch boundary. Recommended: authed desktop client runs real HTTP, ManagedConnectors, Composio parse, ingestion, morning-task, and a forced fetch error. Scan client, logs, diagnostics, rows. No customer keys.
assertions: Only gateway fetch boundary sees the canary; client gets none.
Canary absent from HTTP responses, diagnostics, and tasks.
Canary absent from persisted mail, tasks, and errors.
Missing key fails closed at gateway; client is never asked for it.

interpretationLimits: Forged B account input may be rejected or remain pinned to authenticated A according to the existing public contract; never fetch or persist B. Do not invent a new account-selection behavior from this review.

Exercise cancellation and revocation separately. The stale in-flight response/generation must not replay; a fresh explicitly authorized sync after cancellation or reauthorization may still be allowed.
Canary scans should include error paths and captured logs/diagnostics, not only successful JSON responses. Use fictional provider responses and keys only.
notProven: Actual customer accounts or Windows/macOS device behavior
Full context or tool availability isolation
